author: More Perfect Union
description:
Kathy Hochul's biggest donors are running a $10 million campaign against a tax increase on the rich.

While the governor lobbies against the tax increase in Albany, her billionaire donors like the Rudin family are bankrolling the Coalition for New York’s Future.

They’re trying to block Mamdani’s tax proposals that would put them on the hook for a 2% tax increase.

title: We Found the REAL Reason Kathy Hochul Won’t Tax the Rich

author: More Perfect Union
description:
If Waymo gets its way, 2 million workers will be out of work.

When Waymo gets a firm hold on a city, wages go down. Some drivers now have to work 12 hours day, 7 days a week just to get by.

This isn't inevitable — but Big Tech is spending millions to make you think it is.
